items.q: Taft began to clean up at that time -- he had charge of the brass

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

He say, "Maybe that's what Chick needed all the time. Need somebody to give the band a lift," you know. And I tried to do that. And I had an idea of always -- perfection or something. When I joined the band, a lot of things I didn't know about Chick's band. I said - we (inaudible) started calling rehearsal, you know. And we began to clean up things. Taft began to clean up at that time -- he had charge of the brass -- and he began to clean up the brass section -- trombone and things like that. And we began to work…
The different sections would start working --
